label: Line 8a, column (h): gain
description: Schedule D (2025) line 8a, column (h): totals for transactions not reported on Form 8949, for the bounded covered-long-term-gain class (ADR-0052 Decision 3). Column (h) is column (d) minus column (e); each is itemized separately in the Schedule D attachment's own citation walk.

published_value.explain: Schedule D line 8a, column (h), is long-term proceeds minus basis for the sales you report directly on Schedule D.

computed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 8a, column (h), is zero because your long-term proceeds equal your basis.

closure_backed_zero.explain: You said you have no long-term sales reported directly on Schedule D, so line 8a, column (h), is zero.

blocked.explain: Schedule D line 8a, column (h), has no value yet. It is waiting for your long-term proceeds and basis, or for each sale recorded there to pass its checks. A sale your answers place outside this return, a sale flagged as ordinary income, market discount, a qualified opportunity fund investment, or a collectibles or other special-rate gain, and a sale also recorded as a short-term sale are outside what this return computes. So is a sale with an adjustment you make yourself, unless the adjustment corrects a wrong basis the Form 1099-B reported; record that sale as a sale whose reported basis is wrong. A sale whose own proceeds or basis row is missing or differs from the sale, a sale that says it is of the other term, and a sale with a wash-sale loss disallowed in box 1g (record it as a code W sale) are also outside what this return computes.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No line 8a value exists for this route.
